targets.review_note: Every already used row or column is unavailable to any new domino. New vertical dominoes choose a matching of adjacent free rows, and new horizontal dominoes choose a matching of adjacent free columns. Count these path matchings by a polynomial DP that either skips the current vertex or pairs it with its free predecessor. For v vertical and h horizontal dominoes, assign the h chosen column-pairs injectively to R-2v remaining free rows, and the v chosen row-pairs injectively to C-2h remaining free columns. The product of the two falling factorials and the two matching counts counts each valid extension once. Summing feasible v,h includes the empty extension. Original adjacency is preserved across blocked rows/columns; they are never compressed into false neighboring pairs.
